raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent was tasked with conducting internet searches to gather data on emissions from different energy sources. However, the agent repeatedly navigated to the same NREL dataset page without successfully extracting the necessary data from the EF_Table_FINAL.xlsx file or providing any life-cycle emissions data. This lack of data extraction or redirection to a different strategy led to a failure in delivering the required information to make a well-informed conclusion about which energy resource would improve air quality the most.
